scene.label: Factory world. Pan with the arrow keys, zoom with plus and minus.

connect.title: Join a world
connect.hint: Enter the server address and world id. The player key is stored on this device.
connect.invalidServer: The server address must start with http:// or https:// and carry no path.
connect.invalidWorld: The world id may only use lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores.
connect.failed: Could not join the world. Check the address and that the world is open.
connect.simMismatch: This client does not match the server simulation version; update the app.
connect.unsupportedMode: This world runs in area-of-interest mode; this client only shows lockstep worlds.

result.needsOre: Drills can only be built on ore.
result.rateLimited: You are sending commands too fast.
result.unavailable: The server cannot write right now; the world is read-only.

notice.desync: Out of sync, fetching a fresh copy from the server.
